CHI-9697: Jordan came back and the league exhaled too soon. 69 wins, Pippen and Rodman flanking the greatest closer alive. The dynasty didn't rebuild — it just resumed.
CHI-9798: One more ring before they tore it all down. Jordan, Pippen, Rodman, running on fumes and spite. Everybody knew it was ending; nobody could make it end faster.
SAS-9899: Robinson handed the keys to a second-year Duncan and the lockout season belonged to San Antonio. Two seven-footers, zero wasted motion. The blueprint starts here.
LAL-9900: The most unstoppable force of his era, and a 21-year-old who already thought he was better. Shaq dunked, Kobe schemed, Phil watched it work. Ring one of three.
LAL-0001: They stopped pretending anyone could guard them. Shaq was a cheat code, Kobe was the heir who wouldn't wait. 15-1 through the playoffs. Just unfair.
LAL-0102: Three straight, the dynasty fully formed. By now the rest of the West played for second. Shaq in the post, Kobe everywhere else, the trophy a formality.
SAS-0203: Robinson's farewell, Duncan's coronation. The Admiral walked off with a ring and the franchise in steady hands. Fundamentals don't go out of style.
DET-0304: No superstars, no excuses — just five men who'd rather guard you than breathe. Billups iced it, Hamilton never stopped running, Prince and the Wallaces made the paint a no-fly zone. They out-toughed a Hall of Fame Lakers team. Detroit, baby.
SAS-0405: Duncan, Parker, Ginobili — three generations of cold-blooded in one locker room. Manu off the bench like a problem nobody solved. Methodical, bilingual, lethal.
MIA-0506: Shaq brought the gravity, Flash brought the dagger. Down 0-2, Wade simply decided the Finals were his. One of the great individual takeovers, ring attached.
SAS-0607: No drama, no mercy. The Spurs ran the table on Cleveland like a machine clocking out on time. Duncan, Parker Finals MVP, and a defense that never blinked.
BOS-0708: Garnett screamed it into existence — anything is possible. KG, Pierce, Ray Allen, a year together and a banner to show for it. Ubuntu, and the Lakers in six.
LAL-0809: Kobe's first without Shaq, the one that proved it was always him. Gasol gave him a partner, Phil gave him the triangle, and the doubters gave it up.
LAL-0910: Back-to-back, and the sweetest one came over Boston. Kobe willed Game 7 home on a miserable shooting night because losing to the Celtics wasn't an option.
DAL-1011: The fadeaway that wouldn't miss and the team nobody picked. Dirk torched the superteam Heat, Chandler anchored the back, and a whole career got its ring.
MIA-1112: They took their talents to South Beach and finally cashed the check. LeBron, Wade, Bosh — the villains of the league, validated. The promise, delivered.
MIA-1213: 66 wins, 27 straight, peak LeBron. The Ray Allen corner three saved the dynasty and broke San Antonio's heart. The best version of the Big Three era.
SAS-1314: Revenge served in tic-tac-toe passing. The Spurs moved the ball until the Heat dizzied, then put it away. Kawhi arrived, Duncan ascended, basketball as art.
GSW-1415: Curry and Thompson rained it down and changed the geometry of the game. The first crown of the new dynasty — light, fast, and three-pointers for days.
CLE-1516: Down 3-1 to the 73-win Warriors, LeBron dragged Cleveland back from the dead. The block, the three, the promise kept. A city's 52-year wait, over.
GSW-1617: Durant joined a 73-win team and the league filed a complaint. The Death Lineup with a second MVP — five shooters, no answer. Basketball on easy mode.
GSW-1718: Back-to-back, and they swept the Cavs to do it. Durant, Curry, Iguodala off the bench — every closeout a foregone conclusion. The dynasty at full cruelty.
TOR-1819: Kawhi's one perfect season, the load managed straight to a title. The Game 7 buzzer-beater that bounced four times, then a whole country celebrated. North.
LAL-1920: LeBron and AD in the Orlando vacuum, ring for Kobe. No crowd, no road games, no doubt — the Lakers were the best team in the strangest season ever played.
MIL-2021: The Greek Freak refused to leave and then refused to lose. 50 in the closeout, the block on Ayton, a small-market title carried on two enormous shoulders.
GSW-2122: Everyone wrote them off after the injuries. Curry answered with Finals MVP at last and a fourth ring. The splash, the dynasty, back from the ashes.
DEN-2223: The big man who sees the whole floor before you do. Jokic triple-doubled Denver to its first title, Murray beside him, the league still underrating him somehow.
BOS-2324: The most complete team in years, and they knew it all season. Tatum and Brown finished what Boston started, raising the franchise's record-breaking 18th.
OKC-2425: The MVP turned a young Thunder team into a finished one. Gilgeous-Alexander's midrange clinic, a deep roster, and Oklahoma City's first ring. The future, now.
GSW-1516: The best regular season anyone's ever played — and the one that got away. Curry's unanimous MVP, a record that may never fall, and a 3-1 lead they'll never forget.
LAL-0304: Shaq, Kobe, Malone, and Payton chasing one ring together. Two all-time greats joined for a coronation and got Detroit instead. The cautionary tale of stars.
PHX-0607: Nash conducting offense as performance art, seven seconds and a problem for you. The most fun team that never won — fouled, suspended, and robbed of its shot.
SAC-0102: The passing that should've won a title. Webber, Bibby, Divac, Stojakovic moving the ball like a rumor. Game 6 still keeps Sacramento up at night.
PHI-0001: 165 pounds of refusal. The MVP carried a role-player roster to the Finals and stepped over Tyronn Lue to remind everyone whose stage it was. The Answer.
OKC-1112: Durant, Westbrook, Harden — three future MVPs, too young and too soon. They reached the Finals and got schooled, then got broken up before they could grow.
CLE-0809: MVP, 66 wins, a city's whole hope on one set of shoulders. The first great Cleveland team, one Orlando series short. The ring would have to wait, and travel.
HOU-1718: 65 wins and a Game 7 from dethroning the Warriors — then the threes stopped falling, 27 straight misses. Harden's MVP year, an inch from history.
MEM-1213: The floor was lava in Memphis. Gasol, Randolph, Conley, Tony Allen — they'd muck up your beautiful offense and dare you to play their way. Defense as identity.
LAC-1314: Throw it anywhere near the rim and Blake or DeAndre would finish the sentence. Chris Paul running the show, the most electric team that never broke through.
BKN-2021: Durant, Kyrie, Harden — for sixteen healthy games, the scariest team alive. Then the injuries, the centimeter, the what-if. Basketball's great unfinished draft.
PHI-1819: Trust the Process, then watch it almost work. Embiid bullying the paint, Simmons everywhere but the three-point line. Kawhi's bounce ended it. So close.
HOU-1920: No center, switch everything, live and die by the three. Harden and Westbrook reinventing the position out of existence. The boldest gamble that didn't cash.
DEN-0607: Two of the purest scorers alive, a mile high and a problem for any defense. Iverson and Anthony putting up points in bunches — fireworks short of a title.
HOU-9697: Hakeem, Drexler, and Barkley chasing one more before the legs gave out. Three Hall of Famers, all past their peak, all still terrifying. One last run.
OKC-1516: A win from the Finals on the 73-win Warriors, then it slipped away. Durant and Westbrook had history in their hands. By summer, the partnership was over.
ORL-0809: Dwight Howard at his most unstoppable, ringed by shooters who never missed. They shocked LeBron's Cavs and reached the Finals. Kobe's Lakers ended the cape.
TOR-0001: Vince Carter took flight and the whole league stopped to watch. The most electric leaper of all time, dragging Toronto onto the map one poster at a time.
GSW-0607: The 8-seed that ate the 67-win Mavs alive. Baron Davis, Stephen Jackson, a full-tilt underdog that scared the league straight. Believe, and they did.
